tagline: Clean metadata. Keep the quality. Stay private.
subtitle: Inspect every hidden metadata atom in your video, image, or document. Losslessly remove sensitive tags with verified before-and-after reporting.

dropzone.title: Drop your file here, paste from clipboard, or browse
dropzone.supported: Supports MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI, JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, TIFF, PDF
dropzone.sizeLimit: Max 500 MB • Stored locally in ephemeral memory • Deleted after 60 mins

stages.verifying: Verifying stream packet hashes and diffing tags

limits.title: What Reaboard Can't Do
limits.content: Reaboard does not alter pixels, audio samples, or visible text. It does not remove content watermarks or sensor fingerprints (PRNU). Filename and filesystem creation dates are retained unless randomized.
